title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view without an Agent 365 licence
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap's planned licence removal from Learn's current Agent 365 requirement, and its access paths and commands are supported. Minor corrections should cite the command reference and acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation about who can manage web app access.
